note: Both sets capture the core facts (FIRST FLR 2'-4" above GRADE LEVEL 0", 2" X 8" joist/frame, 3/8" X 4" hex through bolt, 3/4" threaded rod, 1" nut, A6 landscape footing 18"), but Set A makes more misbindings: it assigns the 3/4" X 5 1/2" decking size to the joist, calls the 1" nut a 'nut sleeve', labels the 4X4 post a footing member type, and dumps unrelated 1'-0", 1 1/2" and 7 1/2" dimensions onto 'C1 DECKING' or the landscape footing, plus an invented 'offset from edge to post 1' attribute. Set B keeps the plywood deck and reclaimed wood surface sizes correctly separated, adds the bolt length/head type and plywood thickness, and its errors are mostly dimensions (1 1/4", 3 3/4", 8'-0", 1 1/2") attached to the wrong detail or component. Both sets contain vague 'component 1' entries and duplicates, but Set B is more faithful overall.
